request: Create an Android-only, side-by-side QA build for safely exercising local diagnostics, retention, handled errors, and crash-to-Sentry behavior on a real device.
acceptance: The QA APK installs beside the production app under package com.kamdhenu.handoff.qa and uses an independent data directory.
The QA build is visibly named Kamdhenu Handoff QA and uses a distinct deep-link scheme.
Production and QA APK copy scripts place artifacts under apps/kamdhenu-handoff/releases.
The QA APK bundles release-mode JavaScript so production observability behavior remains active while Android run-as can read its private diagnostic file.
QA-only Settings controls can emit a breadcrumb, capture a handled error, generate a retention probe, and deliberately trigger confirmed JavaScript or native crashes.
Production builds cannot render or execute the QA-only diagnostic controls.
A reusable agent runbook records execution, safety, evidence, environment limitations, known discrepancies, and recovery procedures.
excluded: iOS QA builds or iOS testing.
Changes to the production Android package, version, data, or user-visible behavior.
Remote deployment, TestFlight, Play Store distribution, or public exposure.
Changing Sentry credentials or committing values from ignored environment files.
verification: Run focused QA-build and observability tests.
Run workspace platform checks and the Kamdhenu reference scan.
Build the QA APK and inspect its package, label, version, debuggable flag, permissions, and deep-link scheme.
After the user installs it, verify direct diagnostic-file extraction and the QA probes on the connected Android phone.
rollback: Remove the QA APK from the phone, delete the ignored QA artifact, and revert this local change. The production package and its data remain unchanged.
